representation_discrepancy.interpretation: Exact serialized comparisons reproduce active ranks. The historical helper tolerance merges an almost-equal pair and changes DS/HARN overall tie. This experiment uses exact comparisons solely to reproduce current active data, not to recommend them as the correct long-term tie policy.
representation_discrepancy.proposal: No tie-policy correction proposed or activated; a future correction needs exact versioned owner approval and full low/reference/high comparison.

interpretation.useful_conclusion: DND5/PF2 retained in overall and create top5 across all20 tested single-focalendpoint cases. All other referenceoveralltop10 games leave top5 in at least their own lowM case. This supports prioritizing source-verified shared leader operations over treating close exact ranks as measured demand.
interpretation.PF2_handoff: Existing054/PF2-FILL1 remains proposed; evidence strengthens rationale for reuse analysis if owner approves, not implementation authorization or a new ask. Current051/047 queue not rerouted.
interpretation.threshold: At own lowM, ROOT/CAIRN2/OSE/DW/MOTH fail strict createD>1000 with p/Tfixedreference. This is only a numerical condition, not a new eligible pool. TopN, demand threshold, source suitability and product coverage remain distinct.
interpretation.tie_discrepancy_disposition: Document exact-serialization vs historical-helper tolerance discrepancy at DS/WOD20/HARN. No active fix or new tie method proposed. A correction requires a separate exact version/owner approval and all scenario effects. Top20 is unaffected by this reference mismatch.
not_concluded: No game is proven low-demand or dropped from pool
No calibration ofK/G/p/T or willingness to switch
